description: APPLICATION FOR PROPOSED FIRST FLOOR TERRACE AND ALL ASSOCIATED WORKS.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed first floor roof terrace by reason of its siting, scale, massing and design would result in a visually obtrusive, prominent and incongruous form of development that would adversely impact the character and appearance of the surrounding area to the detriment of the visual amenity of the locality. Therefore, the proposal would be contrary to, in particular National Planning Policy Framework Chapters 4 and 12, London Plan 2021 policies D3 and D4, Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.1, D12.2, D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 2 - The proposed first floor roof terrace by reason of its siting, scale, massing and design considered to create a platform which would result in increased opportunities for overlooking and noise pollution due to prolonged stay and use at roof level which would have a detrimental impact to quality of life and amenity of adjoining neighbours at no. 258 and no. 262 Kingston Road, Raynes Park. Therefore, the proposal would be contrary to, in particular National Planning Policy Framework Chapters 4 and 12, London Plan 2021 policies D3 and D4, Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.1, D12.2, D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 3 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:
"	The application was considered to be fundamentally contrary to the provisions of the Development Plan and the NPPF, and there were not considered to be any solutions to resolve this conflict. 
"	It is noted that the applicant/agent did not engage in any pre-application discussions.
"	The applicant is advised to seek pre-application advice on any resubmission.
